_doc: Real ballot data per school per year. Keyed by school id (same id used in data/schools.json). When an entry exists for (school, year, phase), it overrides the synthesised ballot in data/schools.json at build time. See scripts/scrape-ballot.ts to populate this file from elite.com.sg/ballot. Years not present in this file fall back to synthesised illustrative data and the UI labels them as such.
_source: MOE 2025 via Straits Times graphic (https://www.straitstimes.com — MINISTRY OF EDUCATION source).
